title: Qiskit/OpenQASM Assurance Bridge v0.1 local corpus

measurement_definitions.equivalence: Maximum absolute operator-component error no greater than 1e-9 after optimal global-phase alignment.
measurement_definitions.adapter_overhead: Import plus export elapsed time divided by compiler-only optimization elapsed time, less one; evaluated over all eligible corpus cases.
measurement_definitions.deterministic_evidence_identity: Repeated identical API requests must preserve source, returned artifact, transformation evidence ID, and adapter evidence ID byte-for-field, as exercised by the focused API regression test.
measurement_definitions.qiskit_comparator: Qiskit transpile optimization_level=3 gate count, depth, and elapsed time are descriptive neutral comparators only.

limitations: This corpus does not contain simulator, emulator, provider, or QPU execution evidence.
Operator comparison up to global phase does not authorize embedding the returned artifact as a controlled subcircuit.
The comparison does not establish formal verification or general compiler superiority.
Qiskit level-3 measurements are descriptive; TKET remains a separate future benchmark.
